name: Ammonia Litmus Observation
subject: Gas identification visual regression
educational_goal: Show the indicator paper changing colour while the existing vessel and liquid stay unchanged.

manual_review_reasons: This is an isolated visual test, not a complete salt-analysis procedure. Confirm the preceding preparation against the chosen laboratory manual.
metadata.scope: The source supports gas testing with damp indicator paper. This fixture does not reproduce the source's ammonia preparation apparatus.

clips.name: observe_litmus_paper
clips.state_before: Exactly one existing test tube with colourless prepared reaction mixture; damp red litmus paper is already visible in forceps just above the opening and outside the liquid.
clips.action: Hold the existing damp red litmus paper steady in the ammonia gas above the same tube opening.
clips.state_after: The exposed litmus paper turns blue. The liquid remains colourless; the test tube stays in place.
clips.target_object: the existing damp red litmus paper held by forceps
clips.observable_target: Blue colour develops on the paper only, not in the liquid or on the glass.
clips.quantity_constraint: One test tube and one paper strip throughout. No reagent is added in this shot.
clips.action_pacing: Hold the paper steady; allow the paper colour to change gradually, then hold the result still. No pouring, swirling or time lapse.
clips.procedure_text: With the gas-producing preparation already completed according to the manual, hold damp red litmus paper above the tube opening without contacting the liquid.
clips.observation_text: The damp red litmus paper turns blue; the liquid remains colourless.
clips.image_prompt: One fixed test tube with colourless prepared mixture, one pair of forceps holding a clearly visible damp red litmus strip just above the tube opening, outside the liquid. Fixed close view; no second tube or dropper.

prompt_bundle.stop_condition: The exposed paper is blue and clearly visible; all other objects retain their initial appearance.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: extra test tube, blue liquid, pouring, time lapse, disappearing paper
